svg.text: Dell Deskside Agentic AI - Agentic Coding Architecture
Common deskside base - this solution specializes the Application and Management layers
Developer Tooling - any OpenAI-compatible client, per developer
Coding Assistant API - OpenAI-compatible, no code leaves the desk
Management & Orchestration Layer (same roles, this solution's implementation)
OS Layer - DGX OS / Ubuntu / Windows (distinct OSes, shared package set; functionally common, implemented differently)
DGX OS (Ubuntu-based - Dell Pro Precision with GB10)
Ubuntu (24.04+ - Dell Pro Precision with GB300 / Precision Towers)
Hardware Layer - Dell deskside NVIDIA platforms (common silicon classes, implemented per platform)
Same common base as the reference architecture (Hardware, OS, NVIDIA, Container, Integration) - Application and Management layers are the Agentic Coding specialization.
Clients: any OpenAI-compatible tool | Serving: vLLM + Nemotron 3.5 Lightning NVFP4 (default, all tiers) | S / M / L sizing per system tier
